recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to Expression executable semantics should be tracked under later Expression issues rather than reopening FHIR-27029, because this seed's cardinality and authoring guidance are already present in current build-scope source.
issue_request: FHIR-27029 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core R4 change request, applied for R5, asking that Expression.language have minimum cardinality 0 so authoring-time Measure expressions can be text-only before executable logic or references are available. The approved resolution also required requirements text explaining that optional cardinality supports text-only authoring, but executable content must specify the expression element.
initial_application: PR HL7/fhir#2358 merged on 2022-09-04 and included commit 272e3fb71ecb0d87630a48101b00015f0f18b038, which explicitly cites J#27029. That commit changed source/datatypes/expression.xml from Expression.language 1..1 to 0..1 and added the approved requirements sentence.
additional_context: Expression remains in current build scope through source/fhir.ini as an active metadata datatype, metadatatypes page entry, normative type, and abbreviation. The combined branch already includes FHIR-31082, a later Expression-language decision that preserves the FHIR-27029 authoring use case while requiring language when executable expression or reference content is present. FHIR-I minutes from 2020-11-02 record the persuasive vote, and direct FHIR-27029 community searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because current source/datatypes/expression.xml already has Expression.language cardinality 0..1 and the approved requirements sentence, and the later executable-language invariant is already represented by FHIR-31082 on the combined branch.
